games.Rd

Board games with ratings player counts and playing times A cleaned table of board games listed on BoardGameGeek combining each games community rating with the details a game-night host requires: the number of people that can play how long it takes and the suggested minimum age.

Usage

games

Format

A data frame with 20309 rows and 12 columns:

id

BoardGameGeek game identifier

name

Game name

year

Year published. NA for traditional and ancient games whose year was recorded as 0 or as a BC date

min_players

Minimum number of players

max_players

Maximum number of players

playing_time

Typical playing time in minutes

min_age

Publishers suggested minimum age in years. NA if not recorded

rating

Bayes average rating (1 to 10). This pulls games with few ratings towards the site average so it is more reliable for ranking than the raw average

average_rating

Raw mean user rating (1 to 10)

users_rated

Number of BoardGameGeek users who rated the game

cooperative

TRUE if players work together against the game ' rather than against each other

url

Link to the games BoardGameGeek page

Source

BoardGameGeek https://boardgamegeek.com via the Kaggle BoardGameGeek Reviews dataset by Jesse van Elteren https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/jvanelteren/boardgamegeek-reviews as prepared for TidyTuesday on 25 January 2022 https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/tree/main/data/2022/2022-01-25.

Details

Ratings come from BoardGameGeek users who tend to be gaming enthusiasts and may favour longer more complex games than casual players would. The data is a snapshot from January 2022. Games were removed if their player count or playing time was missing if they allowed more than 20 players (often a code for "unlimited") or if they took longer than 600 minutes. See data-raw/games.R for every cleaning step performed.
